methods.note: Moved, not new: in 1.21.2 Squid (and GlowSquid via Squid) and Dolphin changed superclass from WaterAnimal to the new AgeableWaterCreature, which carries the same override `return false` that WaterAnimal#isPushedByFluid has in 1.21.1 and 1.21.2; Squid and Dolphin are the only subclasses of AgeableWaterCreature, so every entity gets the same value

Renames only: Operation ADDITION/MULTIPLY_BASE/MULTIPLY_TOTAL -> ADD_VALUE/ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE/ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL (same three operations, same loops and arithmetic), AttributeModifier getAmount() -> record accessor amount(), and the attribute field became a Holder so sanitizeValue is reached via attribute.value(); same order of operations and same result
Registry.ATTRIBUTE -> BuiltInRegistries.ATTRIBUTE: the built-in attribute registry moved to BuiltInRegistries in 1.19.3; same registry, same id string, same registered object

1.20.4 Registry.register(Registry, String, T) is register(arg, new ResourceLocation(string), object) -> register by ResourceKey; 1.20.5 Registry.registerForHolder(arg, new ResourceLocation(string), object) registers the same object under the same key (ResourceKey.create(arg.key(), id)) and returns its Holder.Reference instead of the object (the value behind the holder is the same attribute)
new ResourceLocation(string) -> ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace(string): attribute names passed here have no namespace, so both give minecraft:<name>; same registration
ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace -> Identifier.withDefaultNamespace: class rename of the resource id type in 1.21.11; same id, same registration
Moved: 1.20.4 Entity#getEyeHeight(Pose, EntityDimensions) returns arg2.height * 0.85F; 1.20.5 EntityDimensions#defaultEyeHeight(f) returns f * 0.85F with f the height; same float product

Moved: 1.16.1 Entity#setPos computed g = dimensions.width / 2.0F, h = dimensions.height, new AABB(d - g, e, f - g, d + g, e + h, f + g) inline; 1.16.2 makeBoundingBox(d, e, f) has the identical body (called from setPos) and the Vec3 overload just forwards x/y/z

Field-to-Vec3 refactor: velocityX/Y/Z *= 0.98 -> setDeltaMovement(getDeltaMovement().scale(0.98)) (Vec3.scale multiplies each component by the same double); the three |v| < 0.003 zeroings now write locals then setDeltaMovement(h, i, j) with the same values; travel(xxa, yya, zza) -> travel(new Vec3(xxa, yya, zza)) passes the same three values (travel's own change is its own entry); level.profiler -> level.getProfiler() and AABB local renamed lv -> lv2; nothing else changed

setPacketCoordinates(x, y, z) -> syncPacketPositionCodec(x, y, z): 1.18.2 stores new Vec3(x, y, z) in packetCoordinates (the base for relative-move decoding), 1.19 stores the same new Vec3 as the VecDeltaCodec base (packetPositionCodec.setBase); same stored position, used for the same purpose
level().isClientSide field read -> level().isClientSide() accessor, which in 1.21.9 Level returns this.isClientSide; same condition

Local renames (lv/d/e/f -> movement/dx/dy/dz, g/h -> fluidHeight/fluidJumpThreshold, lv2 -> profiler, lv3/lv4/lv5/lv6 -> beforeTravelBox/input/controller/serverLevel) and getType().equals(EntityType.PLAYER) -> is(EntityType.PLAYER), which in 26.1 is TypedInstance#is(T) = typeHolder().value() == rawType, and EntityType does not override equals (identity); same values and branches

EntityType.PLAYER -> EntityTypes.PLAYER (the player type constant moved to EntityTypes); lava jump test !(fluidHeight > threshold) -> isInShallowFluid(FluidTags.LAVA) = getFluidHeight(LAVA) <= getFluidJumpThreshold() (26.2 LivingEntity), and inside the isInLava() branch fluidHeight is exactly getFluidHeight(LAVA), so same test; client-only calculateEntityAnimation(this instanceof FlyingAnimal) -> calculateEntityAnimation(omnidirectionalAirMover()), which is true exactly for Bee and Parrot (the only FlyingAnimal implementors in 26.1.2) plus the new 26.2 SulfurCube; walk animation only
Moved: identical to the inline code in 1.14.4 LivingEntity#causeFallDamage (lv = getEffect(MobEffects.JUMP); h = lv == null ? 0.0F : amplifier + 1; Mth.ceil((f - 3.0F - h) * g))

Parameter/local renames (d/f/e -> fallDistance/damageModifier/baseDamage) and getType().is(EntityTypeTags.FALL_DAMAGE_IMMUNE) -> this.is(tag), which in 26.1 is typeHolder().is(tag) = type.builtInRegistryHolder().is(tag), the same as 1.21.11 EntityType#is(TagKey); same arithmetic
Parameter type Fluid -> FluidState only; the body is still `return false` (overrides are separate methods)

Adds a DamageSource parameter passed through to super.causeFallDamage and hurt(arg, i) in place of the hard-coded DamageSource.FALL; for the ordinary fall path (Block#fallOn passes DamageSource.FALL in 1.17) results and effects are identical; same calculateFallDamage and sounds
velocityX/Y/Z *= -0.2 -> setDeltaMovement(getDeltaMovement().scale(-0.2)): Vec3.scale multiplies each component by the same double; same result
level field -> level() accessor, which in 1.20 Entity returns this.level; same
Indexed for loop over list.get(i) -> for-each over the same List from getEntities; same order, same break on the first LivingEntity
level().isClientSide field -> level().isClientSide() accessor (1.21.9 Level#isClientSide() returns the field); same
`entity instanceof LivingEntity` + cast -> pattern variable `entity instanceof LivingEntity livingEntity`; same test and same argument
Particle position this.x/y/z -> getX()/getY()/getZ(), which in 1.15 Entity return the same x/y/z fields; same

((ServerLevel)this.level()).sendParticles -> lv.sendParticles where lv is the `this.level() instanceof ServerLevel lv` pattern variable already bound by the enclosing condition; same object, same call

Moved: 1.21.1 LivingEntity#travel computed d = getGravity(); bl = getDeltaMovement().y <= 0.0; if (bl && hasEffect(SLOW_FALLING)) d = Math.min(d, 0.01); the new method returns exactly that expression (getGravity is a pure getter); note the call site timing in travelInAir is a separate entry

Moved: 1.15.2 LivingEntity#travel water branch had the identical code inline (if !isNoGravity && !isSprinting: y = bl && |v.y - 0.005| >= 0.003 && |v.y - d/16| < 0.003 ? -0.003 : v.y - d/16, x/z unchanged) applied to getDeltaMovement() right after setDeltaMovement(lv.multiply(f, 0.8F, f)); same values
MobEffects.JUMP renamed MobEffects.JUMP_BOOST in 1.21.5 (same jump_boost effect holder); same expression 0.1F * (amplifier + 1.0F)

Extracted constant: the 1.9.4 LivingEntity#travel water branch used `float h = 0.8F`; 1.10.2 replaced it with this.getWaterSlowDown(), whose LivingEntity body returns 0.8F (the PolarBear override is a separate entry)
lv2.x/this.x, lv2.z/this.z -> getX()/getZ(), which in 1.15 Entity return the same fields; same knockback direction computation

getHealth() <= 0.0F -> isDeadOrDying(), whose 1.16 body is getHealth() <= 0.0F; knockback(lv2, 0.4F, d, e) -> knockback(0.4F, d, e): the dropped Entity argument was unused in 1.15.2 LivingEntity#knockback and no subclass overrode it, so the same values are passed (knockback's own body change is its own entry)
level field -> level() accessor (1.20 Entity#level() returns this.level) in five places; nothing else

Parameter/local renames only (arg/arg2/f -> level/source/damage, g/h/bl/bl2/bl3 -> originalDamage/damageBlocked/blocked/tookFullDamage/success, lv* -> itemInUse/blocksAttacks/projectile/effect/serverPlayer/sourcePlayer, d/e -> xd/zd), plus getType().is(EntityTypeTags.FREEZE_HURTS_EXTRA_TYPES) -> this.is(tag), which is typeHolder().is(tag) = the same builtInRegistryHolder().is(tag); same statements in the same order

The inline knockback block (projectile/source-position direction, knockback(0.4F, xd, zd), indicateDamage if !blocked) was extracted into dealDefaultKnockback(source, damage, blocked), whose 26.2 body is the same code calling knockback(0.4F, xd, zd, source, damage) -> knockback(..., false), whose body equals the 26.1.2 3-arg knockback (the extra arguments are unused); the 26.1.2 knockback overrides (EnderDragon, Creaking) moved to the 5-arg overload with the same bodies; only the new 26.2 SulfurCube overrides dealDefaultKnockback/knockback
MobEffect.JUMP_BOOST (1.8.8 static field) -> MobEffects.JUMP (1.9.4 registry constant): the same jump boost effect; same velocityY = getJumpPower() then += (amplifier + 1) * 0.1F

`float f; if (jump) f = getJumpPower() + 0.1F*(amp+1); else f = getJumpPower();` -> `float f = getJumpPower(); if (jump) f += 0.1F*(amp+1);`: same float addition, getJumpPower called once on each path
this.yRot field -> getYRot(), which in 1.17 Entity returns this.yRot; same sprint impulse
Visibility protected -> public only; body unchanged
onGround field -> onGround() accessor, which in 1.20 Entity returns this.onGround; same expression

Signature gains (DamageSource source, float damage, boolean comesFromEffect), none of which the body uses; body unchanged; the added 5-arg overload forwards with comesFromEffect = false; same result for every call

lv2.getBlock().is(BlockTags.CLIMBABLE) -> lv2.is(BlockTags.CLIMBABLE): 1.17 BlockStateBase#is(Tag) is arg.contains(getBlock()), the same as 1.16.5 Block#is(Tag) = arg.contains(this); trapdoor test uses lv2.getBlock() instead of a local; same

getFeetBlockState() -> getInBlockState(): rename of the same cached lookup (1.20.4 feetBlockState / 1.20.5 inBlockState, both level().getBlockState(blockPosition()) cached and cleared at the same places)
getInt("maxEntityCramming") -> getInt(GameRules.RULE_MAX_ENTITY_CRAMMING), the key object for the same maxEntityCramming rule; same value
level field -> level() accessor (1.20 Entity#level() returns this.level) in four places; nothing else
Indexed loops over list.get(k)/list.get(j) -> for-each over the same List; same order, same counts and pushes
getGameRules().getInt(GameRules.RULE_MAX_ENTITY_CRAMMING) -> getGameRules().get(GameRules.MAX_ENTITY_CRAMMING): 1.21.11 game-rule API rename for the same max entity cramming integer rule
Local renames only (list -> pushableEntities, lv -> serverLevel, i -> maxCramming, j -> count, lv2/lv3 -> entity); same statements

move(dx, dy, dz) -> move(MoverType.SELF, dx, dy, dz) in four places; 1.11.2 Entity#move only branches on the type for PISTON (piston delta clamping) and `(SELF || PLAYER) && onGround && isSneaking && Player` for edge sneaking, which 1.10.2 applied unconditionally, so SELF behaves like the old move (move's own body changes are separate)
fallDistance = 0.0F -> resetFallDistance() in two places; 1.18 Entity#resetFallDistance is `this.fallDistance = 0.0F`

Inline condition (isInWater() || isInLava()) && isAffectedByFluids() && !canStandOnFluid(state) -> shouldTravelInFluid(state), whose 1.21.11 body is exactly that expression and which no class overrides in 1.21.11
level().isClientSide field -> level().isClientSide() accessor (1.21.9 Level returns the field); same

Moved: the water and lava branches of 1.21.1 LivingEntity#travel with the same statements: falling flag and gravity (now getEffectiveGravity, the same expression) taken before moving; water: moveRelative/move/climb 0.2/multiply(f, 0.8F, f)/getFluidFallingAdjustedMovement; lava: same shallow-lava test, scale(0.5), -d/4 when d != 0; then the horizontalCollision isFree(... + 0.6F - getY() + oldY) -> 0.3F step that both old branches ended with; travel's selecting condition (water or lava, affected, !canStandOnFluid) picks the same branch
Visibility private -> protected only (the new 26.2 SulfurCube is the only override); body unchanged
Parameter type LivingEntity -> Player only; body (getRiddenInput, tickRidden, setSpeed(getRiddenSpeed), travel / else branch) unchanged
Drops the `lv2 != null &&` guard: in 1.11.2 Player#getItemBySlot never returns null (armor is a NonNullList, default ItemStack.EMPTY whose item is air, not elytra), so the condition is the same
level field -> level() accessor (1.20 Entity#level() returns this.level); same loop and bounds
level().isDay() -> level().isBrightOutside(): rename, both `!dimensionType().hasFixedTime() && skyDarken < 4` (1.21.4 / 1.21.5 Level)
Rename: 1.15.2 Turtle#isPushedByWater returns false, and the Entity base method and its caller were renamed isPushedByWater -> isPushedByFluid in 1.16; same override body `return false`
Rename: 1.15.2 WaterAnimal#isPushedByWater returns false, and the Entity base method and its caller were renamed isPushedByWater -> isPushedByFluid in 1.16; same override body `return false`
